cards.front: A 33-year-old sees her GP after a second consecutive miscarriage, at 9 weeks. The GP wonders whether to wait for a third loss. Investigation for recurrent miscarriage should be offered [___].
cards.context:
RANZCOG defines recurrent miscarriage as two or more losses of an intrauterine pregnancy; the older threshold was three.

Testing after the second loss includes antiphospholipid antibodies, a treatable association.

reference.title: Miscarriage, Recurrent Miscarriage and Ectopic Pregnancy (C-Gyn 38)
